_about: Synthetic typology rule catalogue for the SAR investigation demo. Thresholds are illustrative demo values, not any bank's monitoring thresholds; descriptions paraphrase public FinCEN and FFIEC red-flag guidance. services/sar/typologies.py reads this file; the rules are deterministic.

typologies.label: Money mule
typologies.reference: FinCEN money-mule red flags; FFIEC BSA/AML Manual appendix F (illustrative paraphrase)

indicators.label: Pass-through: inbound funds left within 48 hours
Many-to-one: distinct unrelated P2P senders in 14 days
Inflow far above the KYC expected activity
Inbound transfers funded by instruments on a fraud list
New account: opened within 90 days of the activity
Cash-out channels: ATM cash, crypto exchange, or P2P out

typologies.label: Structuring
typologies.reference: 31 U.S.C. 5324; FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, structuring red flags (illustrative paraphrase)

indicators.label: Cash deposits just under the $10,000 CTR threshold
Cash above $10,000 in a rolling 7 days with no single deposit at or over it
Statement about avoiding the reporting threshold
Cash far above the KYC expected cash

typologies.label: Funnel account
typologies.reference: FinCEN advisory FIN-2014-A005 on funnel accounts (illustrative paraphrase)

indicators.label: Cash deposits in several states by several depositors
Withdrawals or wires out of area soon after deposits
Low retained balance: under 10% of inflow kept
